# Shared words

[[words: design]]

A design refers to one of these as `[[words/close]]`.

- [[close: word "Close"]] dismissing a dialog
- [[cancel: word "Cancel"]] leaving without saving
- [[all: word ? default:"All"]] a filter with nothing chosen
